MEILI_MASTER_KEY.description: Set at server start; every other key derives from it. Meilisearch says it must be at least sixteen bytes of valid UTF-8, which is the only shape declared here. It administers the instance, so never search with it.

MEILI_SEARCH_KEY.description: The default search key, which Meilisearch says to use to search from the frontend. Read from the instance's own keys endpoint rather than set by you. The name is convention.

MEILI_ADMIN_KEY.description: Writes to indexes. Meilisearch says not to expose admin keys on a public frontend. The name is convention.
